`?` can't turn the `{Source}` from `{callee}` into `{Target}` here

What

`?` can't turn the `{Source}` from `{callee}` into `{Target}` here

Why

`{callee}` is defined at `{definition}` with effective failure contract `{contract}`; the caller's `{caller}` contract has no route from `{Source}` to `{Target}`

Fix

Declare the caller with `{Source}` as its failure domain, or add `impl {Source} -> {Target} { … }`; otherwise handle `{callee}` locally with `??`
